_README: Blank gold-annotation template. Copy to annotations/<document_id>.gold.json and fill in. Prefer `eval_tables.py draft-gold` over starting from this file: it pre-fills the cells from pdfspine's own output so you only correct what is wrong. Format reference: conformance/gt/corpus-finance/README.md. Delete every key starting with `_` except `_draft` before scoring.

tables._bbox_help: Table bounding box in PDF points, origin TOP-LEFT, y grows DOWNWARD (same space find_tables returns). Required for --mode gold-crop; a typical page is 612 x 792.
tables._tags_help: Any of: plain, borderless, multi-header, spanning, wide, tall, multi-table. See TAG_VOCABULARY in conformance/gt/table_gold.py.
tables._cells_help: One entry per cell, top-left position only. `row`/`col` are 0-based; `rowspan`/`colspan` default to 1 and are omitted when 1; `header` marks a header cell; `bbox` is optional (omit it and cell-alignment F1 is skipped for this table, GriTS and TEDS-Struct still score). A spanning cell is listed ONCE, at its top-left position. For a chart page or any page with no table, use "tables": [] and delete this whole object.
